action.objective: Verify b7h7 (Qxh7+) as a single candidate at full depth, confirming queen safety and the pawn-harvesting plan.
action.rationale: Broad search left b7h7 as the only exact-scored candidate (2914, depth 2), winning the h7 pawn with check. Qh7 may be vulnerable to Kg5/Kg6 chase or ...h5-h6 attacks, so exact single-candidate verification at depth 4 is needed before committing. Alternative f1g2 was only an upper bound, not comparable.
